summary: Prioritize referral/group-invite mechanics over paid acquisition and position FellowScript on its group-priced, group-first feature bundle plus church/small-group-leader partnerships; the directional recommendations survive counter-evidence, but four specific figures/framings (the 83% referral-trust stat, the 30% Catholic-partnership figure, the 'calendar timing alone drove the Feb 2024 spike' causal claim, and the blanket 'authenticity beats production' rule) do not and should be dropped or corrected before further use.
